decisive_items: dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern
The tumor was in close contact with peripheral nerves
tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
response.rationale: Only candidate R4 was supplied. The raw spans directly support MPNST through malignant spindle-cell morphology, perivascular atypia with mitoses, nerve association, and S100/p16/neurofilament/CD56 positivity; no competing candidate was provided for contrast.
